info_intro.name: About
info_intro.hint:
Everything here can also be configured from the sidebar WebUI, which is quicker. Open KiraAI's sidebar, then the "All-in-One Browser" plugin page: every option below is editable there (the page is generated from this schema, so new options appear automatically), and changes take effect immediately without restarting KiraAI. The same page also shows connection status, the active backend, extension version, command counters, and the pairing token.

Right after installing the extension, it helps to restart the browser once and reopen this sidebar WebUI page - that is the most reliable way to get connected: a freshly loaded extension may still have its service worker asleep, and reopening wakes it immediately so it picks up the port you are actually using.

zh.name: 说明
zh.hint:
这里的一切都可以在侧边栏 WebUI 里配置，更快捷。 打开 KiraAI 侧边栏 →「全能浏览器」插件页：下面每一项都能在那儿改，改完立刻生效、不用重启；那个页面是照着这份 schema 生成的，以后加了新选项它会自动出现。 同一页还能看连接状态、当前后端、扩展版本、命令计数，以及生成 / 复制接入令牌。

刚装完扩展时，建议把浏览器重新打开一次，再重新打开一次侧边栏 WebUI 页面—— 这样最容易连上：扩展刚加载时它的后台进程可能还在休眠，重开一次会让它立刻醒过来去认你当前这个端口。

zh.name: 启动动画
zh.hint: 打开插件面板时先播一段开场（用插件图标本身做元素），默认开。它会一直盖住页面，直到界面准备好才像笔刷一样抹掉 —— 所以不会出现先看到半截界面、再跳出动画那种感觉。开关本身在面板上切换会立即记住（存本地），不用等保存。

en.hint:
Play a short intro when the panel opens, using the plugin icon itself. It covers the page until the UI is ready, then wipes away. Toggling it on the panel is remembered immediately (stored locally), no save needed.

Default: on.

zh.name: 载入动画重播冷却（秒）
zh.hint: 只有在页面之间来回切、又切回来时，才按这个冷却时间决定要不要重播（默认 90 秒）；每次重新打开这个页面都会播 —— 以前是按时间戳跳过，用户 90 秒内重开就再也看不到开屏动画了。想完全不播，用上面的「启动动画」开关。

en.hint: Cooldown for REPLAYING the boot animation when you switch away and back (default 90s). A fresh page load always plays it. To turn it off entirely, use the Boot Animation switch above.

zh.name: 启用插件
zh.hint:
插件总开关，关掉之后所有浏览器工具都会从模型可见的工具表里消失。

默认：开。

en.hint:
Master switch. When off, all browser tools disappear from the model's tool list.

Default: on.

backend_strategy.name: Backend Strategy
backend_strategy.hint: auto = prefer your browser; use the plugin's own headless browser only when the extension is not connected (the plugin says which one it used). The plugin never switches backends mid-operation - switching is explicit (the bot calls browser_backend, and only while this setting is auto). extension = only your browser. headless = only the headless browser.

zh.name: 后端策略
zh.hint:
auto=优先用你的浏览器；扩展没连上时才用插件自带的无头浏览器（会说明这次用的是哪一套）。插件不会中途自动换后端 —— 失败就是失败，要换得显式切换（bot 调 browser_backend，且只有本项是 auto 时它才切得动）。extension=只用你的浏览器。headless=只用无头浏览器。

默认：auto。

en.hint:
auto = prefer the extension (your own browser, zero conflict) and fall back to the plugin's headless browser when it is not connected; extension = only your browser, never silently downgrade; headless = only the plugin's own headless browser.

Default: auto.

zh.name: 启用扩展桥（用你自己的浏览器）
zh.hint:
是否允许用扩展桥（用你自己开着的浏览器）—— 登录态现成、互不打扰。

默认：开。

en.hint:
Allow the extension bridge, which drives the browser you already have open - your logins just work and nothing gets disturbed.

Default: on.

zh.name: 启用无头回退
zh.hint:
扩展没连上时，是否允许插件自己拉起一个无头浏览器。它使用插件自己的 profile，不会占用你的真实浏览器。

默认：开。

en.hint:
When the extension is not connected, allow the plugin to start its own headless browser. It uses the plugin's own profile, never your real one.

Default: on.

read_only.name: Read Only
read_only.hint: Read-only mode removes all write tools from the model's tool list entirely. Default OFF so the bot has full read/write browser control.

zh.name: 只读模式
zh.hint: 【默认关】让 bot 拥有完整的读写能力（点击/输入/跳转）。打开后写工具会从模型可见的工具表里整个摘掉。

en.hint:
Let the bot have full read and write power (click / type / navigate). When on, write tools are removed from the model's tool list entirely.

Default: off.

zh.name: 写操作需用户确认
zh.hint:
每次写操作前在浏览器里弹通知让你点「允许/拒绝」。仅扩展桥后端支持。

默认：关。

en.hint:
Ask you to allow or deny every write action in the browser. Only supported by the extension backend.

Default: off.

zh.name: 域名白名单
zh.hint:
留空=不限制写操作。填写后，写操作只允许命中这些规则的域名。支持 *.example.com、*bank* 等写法。

默认：空。

en.hint:
Empty means no restriction on write actions. When filled in, write actions are only allowed on domains matching these rules. Supports patterns like *.example.com and *bank*.

Default: empty.

blocked_domains.name: Blocked Domains

zh.name: 域名黑名单
zh.hint:
域名黑名单（读和写都会被拦）。不要把 127.0.0.1 / localhost 写进来：本机是否允许访问由单独的「允许访问本机 / 内网」开关决定；写在这里会因为黑名单优先级最高而让那个开关失效。

默认：*.bank*、*.pay*。

en.hint:
Domains blocked for both reading and writing. Do not list 127.0.0.1 / localhost here: whether local addresses are reachable is controlled by the "Allow local/intranet access" switch, and the blocklist takes priority over it, which would silently disable that switch.

Default: *.bank*, *.pay*.

blocked_domains.hint: Domain blocklist (matched for reads AND writes). Leave loopback entries out of here: whether the AI may reach localhost / 127.0.0.1 is controlled by the separate 「Allow Local / Intranet Access」 switch, so that this list does not silently override it (blocklist has the highest priority).

zh.name: 页面正文最大字符数
zh.hint:
工具返回的页面正文最多多少字符，超出会截断并告诉模型还能续读。

默认：8000。

en.hint:
Maximum characters of page text returned by a tool. Longer content is truncated, and the model is told it can continue reading.

Default: 8000.

content_page_size.name: Content Page Size
content_page_size.hint: How many characters of page text one browser_page call returns by default. This is NOT a hard limit - the bot can pass offset/max_chars to read further, and the return value tells it has_more / next_offset.

zh.name: 单次返回正文长度
zh.hint: browser_page 一次默认返回多少字符。这不是硬上限——bot 可以带 offset/max_chars 继续读，返回值里会告诉它 has_more 和 next_offset，需要多少自己续读。

en.hint: How many characters browser_page returns at a time by default. This is not a hard limit - the bot can continue with offset/max_chars, and the result tells it has_more and next_offset.

inject_page_state.name: Inject Browser State

zh.name: 注入当前浏览状态到提示词
zh.hint:
每轮请求都把「当前后端 / 你正在浏览的标题与网址 / 标签页数」附进上下文，让模型主动察觉你在看什么。

默认关（推荐）：模型只在真正调用浏览器工具时才看到这些 —— 省 token、少噪音；更重要的是你正在访问的网址不会在你聊别的事时被发出去。

⚠️ 开启后：你当前页面的标题和网址会随每一轮请求发给模型服务商，并且插件每 2 分钟会去读一次你浏览器的状态。

en.hint:
Attach the current state (active backend / the title and URL you are viewing / tab count) to every model request so it notices what you are looking at.

Off (recommended): the model only sees this when it actually calls a browser tool - fewer tokens, less noise, and more importantly the URLs you visit are not sent while you are chatting about something else.

When on: the title and URL of your current page are sent every single turn, so only enable it if you really want that.

Default: off.

inject_page_state.hint:
每轮请求都把「当前后端 / 你正在浏览的标题与网址 / 标签页数」附进上下文，让模型主动察觉你在看什么。

默认关（推荐）：模型只在真正调用浏览器工具时才看到这些 —— 省 token、少噪音；更重要的是你正在访问的网址不会在你聊别的事时被发出去。

⚠️ 开启后：你当前页面的标题和网址会随每一轮请求发给模型服务商，并且插件每 2 分钟会去读一次你浏览器的状态。

zh.name: 配置面板需要登录
zh.hint:
打开这个配置面板是否需要先登录 KiraAI。令牌端点始终要求登录，不受这里影响。

默认：开。

en.hint:
Whether opening this config panel requires a KiraAI login. The token endpoint always requires a login regardless of this switch.

Default: on.

zh.name: 命令超时（秒）
zh.hint:
单条命令（扩展桥 / 无头后端）的等待上限，超时即判失败。

默认：20。

en.hint:
How long a single command (extension bridge / headless backend) may take before it is treated as failed.

Default: 20.

zh.name: 无头模式（关闭则显示窗口）
zh.hint:
关掉会显示浏览器窗口（能看到它在你屏幕上操作），调试时有用。

默认：开。

en.hint:
Turn it off to show the browser window and watch it work - handy when debugging.

Default: on.

zh.name: 浏览器来源
zh.hint:
auto=依次尝试系统 Chrome→Edge→Chromium→内置；bundled=只用 Playwright 自带 Chromium。

默认：auto。

en.hint:
auto = try system Chrome, then Edge, then Chromium, then the bundled one; bundled = only the Chromium shipped with Playwright.

Default: auto.

headless_profile_mode.name: Headless Profile Mode
headless_profile_mode.hint: inherit = COPY your real browser's user data into the plugin folder and run on that copy, so logins/cookies/bookmarks are all there while your own browser keeps working (the copy means no ProcessSingleton lock). persistent = plugin-owned profile. temp = throwaway.

zh.name: 无头 profile 模式
zh.hint: 【默认 inherit】复制你真实浏览器的用户数据到插件目录，然后跑在那个副本上——登录态/Cookie/书签全都在，而因为用的是副本，不会持有你浏览器的占用锁，你自己的浏览器照常能用。persistent=插件自己的 profile；temp=用完即弃。

en.hint: inherit (default) copies your real browser's user data into the plugin directory and runs on that copy, so logins/cookies/bookmarks are all there - and because it is a copy, it never holds the lock your own browser uses. persistent = the plugin's own profile; temp = discarded when done.

zh.name: 自定义 profile 目录
zh.hint:
留空则用插件数据目录下的 browser_profile。⚠️ 请不要填你真实浏览器的 User Data 目录 —— 那会导致互相抢锁。

默认：留空。

en.hint:
Leave empty to use browser_profile inside the plugin data directory. Do not point this at your real browser's User Data directory - that makes the two fight over the lock.

Default: empty.

zh.name: 默认视口大小
zh.hint: 无头浏览器的默认视口大小，写成 宽x高。

en.hint: Default viewport size for the headless browser, written as WIDTHxHEIGHT.

zh.name: 自定义 User-Agent（留空即可）
zh.hint: 留空就行 —— 插件已经默认填了一枚合适的：真实桌面浏览器的 UA，不含 Headless 标记，版本号跟浏览器主版本对齐，平台按你的系统推断。不带 Headless 才能正常打开 B站 / 知乎这类站点（带了常见症状是页面能开但内容空、或者弹验证，很难看出是 UA 的问题）。只有需要伪装成别的浏览器/系统时才填这里。

en.hint:
Leave it empty - the plugin already fills in a good one: a real desktop browser UA with no Headless marker, version aligned with the browser's major version, platform inferred from your system. Without the Headless marker, sites like Bilibili or Zhihu open normally (with it you often get an empty page or a captcha, which is hard to trace back to the UA). Only set this if you need to pose as a different browser.

Default: empty.

zh.name: 页面加载超时（秒）
zh.hint:
打开一个页面最多等多久，超时就放弃这次加载。

默认：45。

en.hint:
How long to wait for a page to open before giving up on that load.

Default: 45.

default_wait_until.name: Default Wait Until
default_wait_until.hint: domcontentloaded (recommended) returns as soon as the DOM is ready. load waits for all subresources. networkidle is DISCOURAGED by Playwright: modern pages with polling/keepalive may never go idle, so it just burns the full timeout while the page keeps running.

zh.name: 默认等待策略
zh.hint:
domcontentloaded（推荐）=DOM 就绪即返回；load=等所有子资源；networkidle 官方已标注不推荐——带轮询/长连接的现代页面可能永远不空闲，只会白等到超时，同时页面还在持续跑（烧 CPU）。

默认：domcontentloaded。

en.hint:
domcontentloaded (recommended) returns as soon as the DOM is ready; load waits for all subresources; networkidle is officially discouraged - modern pages with polling or long-lived connections may never be idle, so you just wait until the timeout while the page keeps burning CPU.

Default: domcontentloaded.

op_timeout.name: Operation Timeout (s)
op_timeout.hint: Per-operation timeout, DECOUPLED from the framework's tool_call_timeout by default. The framework's timeout force-cancels our coroutine, which leaves Playwright in an undefined state - so the plugin manages its own deadline instead. Turn on op_timeout_follows_framework if you want it clamped.

zh.name: 页面操作超时（秒）
zh.hint: 【默认与框架脱钩】单个页面操作的超时。框架那个 tool_call_timeout 是到点直接取消我们的协程，中途取消会让 Playwright 留下状态不明的页面，所以默认由插件自己管。想让插件不超过框架上限，打开下面的「跟随框架」。

en.hint: Timeout for a single page operation. The framework's tool_call_timeout cancels our coroutine outright, which leaves Playwright with pages in an unknown state, so by default the plugin manages this itself. Turn on "follow framework" below to keep it under the framework limit.

op_timeout_follows_framework.name: Operation Timeout Follows Framework
op_timeout_follows_framework.hint: ON: clamp op_timeout to tool_call_timeout × op_timeout_ratio. OFF (default): fully decoupled.

zh.name: 操作超时跟随框架
zh.hint: 打开：把 op_timeout 限制在「框架工具超时 × 比例」以内。关闭（默认）：完全脱钩，由插件自己决定何时收手。

en.hint: On: clamp op_timeout to (framework tool timeout x ratio). Off (default): fully decoupled, the plugin decides when to stop.

zh.name: 跟随框架时的比例
zh.hint:
仅在「操作超时跟随框架」打开时生效。

默认：0.8。

en.hint:
Only takes effect when "Operation timeout follows framework" is on.

Default: 0.8.

zh.name: 交互操作超时（秒）
zh.hint:
点击、输入这类单步交互操作的最长等待时间。

默认：20。

en.hint:
How long a single interaction such as a click or a type may take.

Default: 20.

idle_close_seconds.name: Idle Close Seconds
idle_close_seconds.hint: Close the headless browser after this many seconds of inactivity, releasing its CPU and memory. 0 = never close.

zh.name: 空闲自动关闭（秒）
zh.hint:
空闲这么多秒后自动关掉无头浏览器，把 CPU 和内存一起释放。0=不关（会一直常驻）。建议 300。

默认：300。

en.hint:
Close the headless browser after this many idle seconds to release CPU and memory. 0 = never close (it stays resident). 300 is recommended.

Default: 300.

screenshot_dir.name: Screenshot Dir

zh.name: 截图目录
zh.hint: 留空用插件默认值。填 data/xxx 表示 KiraAI 数据目录下的 xxx（和框架 「<file>」 标签同一规矩，不是当前工作目录下的 data/）；也可直接填绝对路径。默认：「<数据目录>/temp」（框架的临时区，本身会被自动清理）

en.hint: Leave empty for the plugin default. A value like data/xxx means xxx inside the KiraAI data directory (same rule as the framework's <file> tag, not the data/ under the current working directory); an absolute path also works.

screenshot_dir.hint: 留空用插件默认值。填 data/xxx 表示 KiraAI 数据目录下的 xxx（和框架 「<file>」 标签同一规矩，不是当前工作目录下的 data/）；也可直接填绝对路径。默认：「<数据目录>/temp」（框架的临时区，本身会被自动清理）

download_dir.name: Download Dir

zh.name: 下载目录
zh.hint: 留空用插件默认值。填 data/xxx 表示 KiraAI 数据目录下的 xxx（和框架 「<file>」 标签同一规矩，不是当前工作目录下的 data/）；也可直接填绝对路径。默认：「<数据目录>/files」（框架 「<file>」 标签的文件区）。自动清理作用在此目录

en.hint: Leave empty for the plugin default. A value like data/xxx means xxx inside the KiraAI data directory (same rule as the framework's <file> tag, not the data/ under the current working directory); an absolute path also works. Auto-cleanup applies to this directory.

download_dir.hint: 留空用插件默认值。填 data/xxx 表示 KiraAI 数据目录下的 xxx（和框架 「<file>」 标签同一规矩，不是当前工作目录下的 data/）；也可直接填绝对路径。默认：「<数据目录>/files」（框架 「<file>」 标签的文件区）。自动清理作用在此目录

zh.name: 截图最大保留数
zh.hint:
截图目录里最多保留多少张，超出按时间从旧到新删。

默认：50。

en.hint:
How many screenshots to keep in the screenshot directory; older ones are removed first.

Default: 50.

zh.name: 自动清理旧截图
zh.hint:
是否自动清理旧截图（按上面的数量上限）。

默认：开。

en.hint:
Whether to clean up old screenshots automatically, using the count limit above.

Default: on.

zh.name: 自动清理下载目录
zh.hint:
是否自动清理下载目录里的旧文件（按上面的数量上限）。

默认：开。

en.hint:
Whether to clean up old files in the download directory automatically, using the count limit above.

Default: on.

zh.name: 下载文件最大保留数
zh.hint:
下载目录里最多保留多少个文件，超出按时间删旧的。

默认：100。

en.hint:
How many files to keep in the download directory; older ones are removed first.

Default: 100.

download_timeout.name: Download Timeout (Seconds)
download_timeout.hint: How long a single download may take before it is aborted. Downloads run in the background while the tool call returns immediately, so this is a safety net against hanging connections rather than a per-call deadline. Default 600s (10 minutes).

zh.name: 下载超时（秒）
zh.hint: 单次下载最长允许多久，超时即中止。下载是在后台进行的（工具调用会立刻返回），所以这个是防止连接卡死的兜底，而不是单次调用的截止时间。默认 600 秒（10 分钟）。

en.hint:
Longest a single download may take, aborted when exceeded. Downloads happen in the background (the tool call returns immediately), so this is a safety net against stuck connections rather than a per-call deadline.

Default: 600.

download_max_bytes.name: Max Download Size (Bytes)
download_max_bytes.hint: Reject downloads larger than this. Downloads are streamed to disk in 64KB chunks, so this is NOT a memory guard - memory stays flat no matter the size. Default 2GB.

zh.name: 单个下载大小上限（字节）
zh.hint: 超过该大小会被拒绝。下载是流式落盘（64KB 一块），无论多大都不占内存——这个上限只用来拦异常的超大文件。默认 2GB。

en.hint:
Anything larger is rejected. Downloads stream to disk in 64KB chunks, so memory use is not a concern at any size - this limit only exists to catch abnormally large files.

Default: 2147483648.

upload_max_bytes.name: Max Upload Size (Bytes)
upload_max_bytes.hint: Max file size for browser upload. Default 256MB. Uploads are streamed as MULTIPLE messages and the chunks are accumulated in the PAGE context (content script), never in the service worker — so neither the WebSocket frame size nor the SW memory is a constraint. Peak memory is about 1x the file size (measured 1.0-1.1x).

zh.name: 上传文件大小上限（字节）
zh.hint: 通过扩展上传文件时的大小上限。默认 256MB。上传走分块流式（多条消息），且分块累积在页面上下文（内容脚本），不在 service worker —— 所以单帧尺寸和 SW 内存都不是约束。峰值内存约等于文件大小（实测 1.0～1.1×）。

en.hint:
Size limit when uploading a file through the extension. Uploads are streamed in chunks (multiple messages) accumulated in the page context (content script) rather than the service worker, so neither frame size nor service-worker memory is a constraint. Peak memory is roughly the file size (measured 1.0-1.1x).

Default: 268435456.

upload_allow_any_path.name: Allow Any Upload Path
upload_allow_any_path.hint: ON (default): any readable local file can be uploaded - this plugin is meant to give the bot full browser capability. OFF: only files under upload_allowed_dirs.

zh.name: 允许上传任意路径
zh.hint: 【默认开】允许上传任意可读文件 —— 本插件的定位是给 bot 完整的浏览能力。关掉后只允许 upload_allowed_dirs 里的目录，可防止本机敏感文件被外传。

en.hint:
Allow uploading any readable file - this plugin exists to give the bot a full browsing capability. When off, only directories in upload_allowed_dirs are allowed, which prevents sensitive local files from being exfiltrated.

Default: on.

zh.name: 上传目录白名单
zh.hint:
仅当「允许上传任意路径」关闭时生效。用 realpath 归一，可防 ../ 穿越。

默认：data/files、data/temp。

en.hint:
Only applies when "Allow uploading any path" is off. Paths are resolved with realpath, so ../ traversal is blocked.

Default: data/files, data/temp.

local_access.name: Allow Local / Intranet Access
local_access.hint: ON (default): the AI may open localhost, 127.0.0.1 and intranet addresses - including your own dev servers (e.g. http://localhost:3000) AND KiraAI's own web panel. This plugin exists to let the AI operate a browser for you, so local pages are normal work targets, not an attack surface. OFF: block loopback / private / link-local / CGNAT entirely - that covers the cloud metadata endpoints used by AWS/Azure/GCP (169.254.169.254) and Alibaba Cloud (100.100.100.200), and it also resolves hostnames to see whether they land on an intranet address. Note: in a fake-IP proxy setup hostnames resolve to the proxy's placeholder range, so that last step can't tell - in that setup the browser goes through the proxy too, so it can't reach the intranet anyway. Worth knowing before turning it OFF: if you keep it ON while the panel has no auth, the AI could open the panel and change plugin settings.

zh.name: 允许访问本机 / 内网
zh.hint: 开启（默认）：AI 可以打开 localhost / 127.0.0.1 / 内网地址 -- 包括你自己的本地开发服务器（如 http://localhost:3000）以及 KiraAI 自身的面板。本插件的定位就是「让 AI 帮你操作浏览器」，本机页面是正常的工作目标，不是攻击面，所以默认放开。关闭：本机 / 内网 / 链路本地 / CGNAT 一律拒绝 —— 覆盖 AWS/Azure/GCP 的元数据端点 169.254.169.254 与阿里云的 100.100.100.200；同时会把主机名真解析一次，看它是不是落到内网地址。注意：fake-IP 代理环境里主机名会解析到代理的占位段，这一步判不出来（但那种环境下浏览器也走代理，实际到不了内网）。关闭前值得知道：如果保持开启、而面板又没有认证，AI 理论上可以打开面板并修改插件配置。

en.hint: On (default): the AI may open localhost / 127.0.0.1 / intranet addresses, including your own local dev servers (e.g. http://localhost:3000) and KiraAI's own panel. This plugin exists so the AI can operate a browser for you, so local pages are a normal work target rather than an attack surface.

local_file_access.name: Allow Opening Local Files
local_file_access.hint: ON (default): the AI may open local files in the browser - images, PDFs, text, video, HTML. This is what "take a look at this picture / this PDF" needs, and it works in the plugin's own headless browser as well as in yours. OFF: file:// addresses are refused entirely (use this if you don't want the AI to reach anything on your disk). Note this is a separate switch from "Allow Local / Intranet Access" (that one is about localhost web servers). For your own browser, Chromium also has its own per-extension "Allow access to file URLs" toggle - if it's off, the plugin tells you exactly how to turn it on.

zh.name: 允许打开本机文件
zh.hint: 开启（默认）：AI 可以用浏览器打开本机文件 —— 图片、PDF、文本、视频、HTML 等。这就是「帮我看看这张图 / 这份 PDF」所需要的，插件自带的无头浏览器和你自己的浏览器都支持。关闭：file:// 一律拒绝（不想让 AI 碰到你磁盘上任何东西时用）。注意这与上面的「允许访问本机 / 内网」是两个开关：那一个管的是 localhost 上的网页服务，这一个管的是磁盘文件。另外，用你自己的浏览器时 Chromium 还有一个「允许访问文件网址」的扩展级开关；如果它没开，插件会告诉你怎么开。

en.hint: On (default): the AI may open local files in the browser - images, PDFs, text, video, HTML. This is what "take a look at this picture / this PDF" needs. Off: file:// addresses are refused entirely. This is separate from "Allow Local / Intranet Access" (that one is about localhost web servers).

file_allow_any_path.name: Allow Opening Any Path
file_allow_any_path.hint: ON (default): any local path may be opened - images and documents are often on the Desktop or in the Downloads folder, and this is the same permissive default as "Allow uploading any path". OFF: only paths under "Allowed local file directories" are permitted. Paths are resolved with realpath, so ../ traversal is blocked. Note: network shares (file://server/share) are refused in both cases - that's not a local file.

zh.name: 本机文件允许任意路径
zh.hint: 开启（默认）：任意本机路径都能打开 —— 图片和文档常在桌面或下载目录里，而这与上面的「上传允许任意路径」是同一个取向。关闭：只允许「本机文件目录白名单」里的目录。路径会用 realpath 归一，能防 ../ 穿越。注意：网络共享（file://server/share）在两种情况下都会被拒 —— 那不是本机文件。

en.hint: On (default): any local path may be opened. Off: only paths under "Allowed local file directories" are permitted (realpath-resolved, so ../ traversal is blocked).

file_allowed_dirs.name: Allowed Local File Directories
file_allowed_dirs.hint:
Only applies when "Allow opening any path" is off. Paths are resolved with realpath, so ../ traversal is blocked.

Default: data/files, data/temp, data/downloads.

zh.name: 本机文件目录白名单
zh.hint:
只在「本机文件允许任意路径」关闭时生效。路径会用 realpath 归一，能防 ../ 穿越。

默认：data/files、data/temp、data/downloads。

en.hint:
Only applies when "Allow opening any path" is off. Paths are resolved with realpath, so ../ traversal is blocked.

Default: data/files, data/temp, data/downloads.

zh.name: 允许跨机配对
zh.hint:
默认关闭：扩展的「自动接入」只能从本机读取端口和令牌。
开启后，同一网络里任何机器都能读到令牌并连上你的浏览器 —— 只有当你「浏览器和 KiraAI 不在同一台机器」时才需要打开，并且请自行确保网络可信。

en.hint: Default off: the extension's auto-pairing can only read the port and token from this machine. When on, any machine on the same network can read the token and connect to your browser - only enable it when the browser and KiraAI are on different machines, and make sure the network is trustworthy.

load_cookies_on_start.name: Auto-load Cookies
load_cookies_on_start.hint: On startup, load every .json in the cookie directory into the headless browser, so saved logins survive reinstalls / profile changes / a different machine. Pair with browser_cookie(action="export") to save a site's cookies here. Failures never block the browser from starting.

zh.name: 启动时自动加载 Cookie
zh.hint:
启动无头浏览器时，把 cookie 目录下的所有 .json 灌回去 —— 这样重装插件、换 profile、换机器之后，登录态还能找回来。配合 browser_cookie(action="export") 把某个站点的 cookie 导出到这里即可。任何文件有问题都只跳过它，不会影响浏览器启动。

默认：开。

en.hint:
When starting the headless browser, load every .json in the cookie directory back in - so logins survive a reinstall, a profile change or a machine change. Export a site's cookies there with browser_cookie(action="export"). A broken file is skipped and never blocks the browser from starting.

Default: on.

cookies_dir.name: Cookie Directory
cookies_dir.hint: 留空用插件默认值。填 data/xxx 表示 KiraAI 数据目录下的 xxx（和框架 「<file>」 标签同一规矩，不是当前工作目录下的 data/）；也可直接填绝对路径。默认：「<数据目录>/files/cookie」

zh.name: Cookie 目录
zh.hint:
各个站点的 cookie JSON 存放目录（一个站点一个文件，如 chatgpt.json）。上面的开关打开时会在启动时自动加载。

默认：data/files/cookie。

en.hint:
Where per-site cookie JSON files live (one file per site, e.g. chatgpt.json). When the switch above is on, they are loaded at startup.

Default: data/files/cookie.

auto_download_browser.name: Auto-download Browser
auto_download_browser.hint: If every browser source fails to start, download Playwright's bundled Chromium and use that. This is the last fallback; the usual cause of reaching it is that playwright is installed but 「playwright install chromium」 was never run. Turn off to fail fast instead of downloading.

zh.name: 自动下载浏览器
zh.hint:
所有浏览器来源都启动失败时，自动下载 Playwright 自带的内置 Chromium 来用。这是最后一级回退 —— 通常走到这一步的原因是「装了 playwright 但没跑过 playwright install chromium」。关掉则直接报错、不下载。

默认：开。

en.hint:
When every browser source fails to start, download the Chromium bundled with Playwright as a last resort - usually because playwright is installed but "playwright install chromium" was never run. When off, the plugin reports the error instead of downloading.

Default: on.

auto_download_timeout.name: Browser Download Timeout
auto_download_timeout.hint: Seconds to allow for the automatic browser download. On timeout the startup fails with a manual command to run instead of hanging forever.

zh.name: 浏览器下载超时（秒）
zh.hint:
自动下载浏览器的超时时间。超时会失败并给出手动安装命令，而不是无限等下去。

默认：600。

en.hint:
Timeout for downloading the browser. On timeout it fails and prints the manual install command rather than waiting forever.

Default: 600.

screenshot_restore_window.name: Restore Window For Screenshot
screenshot_restore_window.hint:
Briefly restore a minimized window to take the screenshot, then put it back. The browser cannot read a frame while the window is not visible, so screenshots fail there. The window may flash for a moment.

Default: on.

zh.name: 截图时临时恢复窗口
zh.hint:
窗口被最小化（或被完全挡住）时，截图前先把它临时恢复出来，截完立刻还原—— 窗口不可见时浏览器读不到画面，截图必然失败。会短暂闪一下窗口；不想看到就关掉（那样截图会直接失败）。只影响扩展后端的可视区域截图。

默认：开。

en.hint:
Briefly restore a minimized window to take the screenshot, then put it back. The browser cannot read a frame while the window is not visible, so screenshots fail there. The window may flash for a moment.

Default: on.

auto_describe_screenshot.name: Describe Screenshot (VLM)
auto_describe_screenshot.hint: Use a VLM to turn screenshots into TEXT so the bot can actually see the page. Needed because tool results are plain text - an image never enters the model's context by itself. The bot can override this per call with the describe parameter (set it false when it only wants to show the picture to you). Works with BOTH backends.

zh.name: 用 VLM 分析截图
zh.hint:
开启后，截图会交给 VLM 转成文字描述回给 bot —— 这样它才能「看到」页面。为什么需要：工具结果是以文本进模型的，图片本身不会自动进入它的上下文。bot 每次也能自己决定：给 browser_screenshot 传 describe=false 就只截图不描述（只想让你看图时更省）。两个后端都适用（扩展 / 无头都行）。

默认：开。

en.hint:
When on, screenshots are turned into text by a VLM and handed to the bot - that is how it can "see" a page. Tool results reach the model as text, so the image itself never enters its context automatically. The bot can also decide per call: pass describe=false to browser_screenshot to just take the picture without describing it.

Default: on.

vlm_model.name: VLM Model
vlm_model.hint: Which model to use for screenshot analysis. Leave EMPTY to use the default VLM configured in KiraAI's model settings - that is the normal choice unless you want this plugin to use a different one. Must be a vision-capable model.

zh.name: VLM 模型
zh.hint: 用哪个模型分析截图。留空即可 —— 留空会使用 KiraAI 模型设置里的默认 VLM（这是通常该选的）。只有想让本插件单独指定一个模型时才需要在这里选。必须选支持视觉的模型。

en.hint: Which model analyses screenshots. Leave it empty to use the default VLM from KiraAI's model settings (usually what you want). Only pick a model here if you want this plugin to use a specific one. It must support vision.

vlm_describe_prompt.name: VLM Describe Prompt
vlm_describe_prompt.hint: Custom prompt for screenshot analysis. Empty uses the built-in web-page-oriented prompt (which asks for page type, interactive elements, current state, key content and suggested next actions).

zh.name: VLM 描述提示词
zh.hint:
自定义截图分析提示词。留空则使用内置的网页分析提示词（会要求输出：页面类型 / 可交互元素清单 / 当前状态 / 关键内容 / 建议的下一步操作），这样描述能直接用于后续操作。

默认：留空。

en.hint:
Custom prompt for screenshot analysis. Leave it empty to use the built-in web-analysis prompt (it asks for page type / interactive elements / current state / key content / suggested next step), which keeps the description directly usable for later actions.

Default: empty.

zh.name: 写操作后一并返回页面内容
zh.hint: 默认开，建议保持。框架有「每轮最多 5 次工具调用」的限制（bot_config.agent.max_tool_calls_per_turn），而「点一下 → 再看一眼」如果各占一次调用，5 次只够两轮半 —— 日志里满屏 「Tool call limit exceeded ... skipping tool 'browser_page'」 就是这么来的。开着的话，每次点击/输入/导航都会顺手把新页面内容一起带回来（扩展内部命令不计次，所以是白赚），同样的调用预算能干两倍的事、还少一次往返。

en.hint: On by default, best kept that way. The framework allows at most 5 tool calls per turn (bot_config.agent.max_tool_calls_per_turn), and "click, then look again" would use two - the log then fills with "Tool call limit exceeded". Returning the page together with the write result costs the same as the click itself and saves a round trip.

zh.name: 允许读取浏览历史（默认关）
zh.hint:
默认关，建议保持。开着的话 bot 能通过 browser_interact(action="history") 搜索你最近看过的网页 —— 这是你没主动交出来的隐私数据，一旦开了，你打开过的地址就会按需发给模型。

书签（action="bookmarks"）不受这个开关限制 —— 书签是你主动收藏的，性质不一样。

要开的话：想清楚再开；开完 browser_diag 的 status 里会一直显示这个状态。

en.hint:
Off by default, best kept that way. When on, the bot can search the pages you recently visited through browser_interact(action="history") - that is private data you never handed over, and once it is on, the addresses you opened are sent to the model on demand.

Bookmarks (action="bookmarks") are not affected by this switch - a bookmark is something you deliberately saved.

vlm_timeout.name: VLM Timeout
vlm_timeout.hint: Seconds to wait for the VLM description (default 60). On timeout the description is skipped - the screenshot itself still succeeds.

zh.name: VLM 超时（秒）
zh.hint: 等待 VLM 描述的超时时间（默认 60）。超时会跳过描述 —— 截图本身仍然成功、也仍然会发给你，只是 bot 这次没拿到描述。

en.hint:
How long to wait for a VLM description. On timeout the description is skipped - the screenshot itself still succeeds and is still sent to you, the bot just does not get a description this time.

Default: 60.

zh.name: VLM 前自动压缩图片
zh.hint: 默认开，建议保持。不压的话：截图会以原尺寸转成 base64（1920×1080 就是好几 MB）再配 high detail 发给模型 —— 又慢又贵，还经常直接超时（日志里那条『VLM 描述超时』多半就是这个）。压过之后正常几秒就回来。

en.hint: On by default, best kept that way. Without compression, a screenshot goes to the model as a full-size base64 image (several MB at 1920x1080) with high detail - slow, expensive, and often a straight timeout. Compressed, a description normally comes back within seconds.

zh.name: 压缩：最长边（像素）
zh.hint: 图片最长边压到这个尺寸（默认 1280）。截图里的按钮文字通常还看得清；嫌看不清可以调到 1600。

en.hint:
Longest edge the image is scaled down to. Button labels in screenshots are usually still legible; bump it to 1600 if they are not.

Default: 1280.

zh.name: 压缩：JPEG 质量
zh.hint: 重新编码的质量（默认 85，1-100）。调高更清晰但更大。

en.hint:
JPEG re-encoding quality (1-100). Higher is sharper but bigger.

Default: 85.
